sonnet.problem: The story card says that if those days kept going, nobody would be saved. That rules out the wrong answer 'They will be stretched out' on the next choice card and hints at the right one.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The card says Jesus' words 'echo the prophet Isaiah (Isaiah 13:10)'. Neither Matthew 24:29 nor Isaiah 13:10 states this connection.
sonnet.rule: When he connects two passages, or explains what a law was for, he says only what the texts state.

sonnet.problem: The wrong answer 'sing' (stars will sing from the sky) is silly and not believable next to 'fall'.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly.

sonnet.problem: 'And there's a loud trumpet call' puts a future prediction in the present tense. The text says the angels will be sent out with a loud trumpet call.
The question says 'they will know that He is near. How near?' That rules out the wrong answer 'Still a long way off'.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
